title: Amal Clooney Ticks off Every Fall Style Classic at the Theater

 By María Munsuri November 6, 2026 Photo: Darla Khazei/INSTARimages Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story Amal Clooney has always been a fan of a statement look, never missing an opportunity to wear archival couture in Cannes , punchy prints in the Med , or dazzling sequins on the red carpet. But formalwear and vacation wardrobe aside, her everyday style is a little more down-to-earth , as evidenced by her latest appearance in New York, which saw Mrs. Clooney opt for an everywoman approach to a fall look—albeit in a fittingly elevated way.
 Photo: Darla Khazei/INSTARimages Joined by her husband George Clooney, she was photographed leaving Seaview Studio over the weekend in an understated look, wearing a long suede coat over her monochrome outfit. Amal also added a couple more fall favorites to her seasonal outerwear: a pair of suede boots and a Bordeaux manicure .
 While the scene had all the makings of a romantic date, the couple leaving the venue hand in hand, there was a professional reason for the pair’s outing: George was presenting a one-off charity reading of Clark Gregg’s play Smear , in which he shared the stage with actors including Betty Gilpin, Laverne Cox, and Adam Scott.
 Parking the Old Hollywood glamour for a more relaxed approach, Amal’s choice of outerwear confirmed that a suede jacket deserves a place in every transitional wardrobe , whether you’re popping to the grocery store, or in her case, supporting your movie star husband on a night at the theater.
 As temperatures continue to drop, we’ll be keeping tabs on Amal Clooney’s wardrobe and taking notes.
